_doc: Aluminium alloy EN AW-6005A T6, extruded, for analysis: what framing profiles are made of. Strengths are the least EN 755-2:2016 allows for a wall of 5 mm or less (an open profile; a hollow one 215 and 255), as Hydro's data sheet gives them; a maker's own profile may be stronger. No fatigue figure: the sheet gives none.
name: al6005a-t6

modulus.source: Hydro, Technical datasheet, Extruded products, Alloy EN AW-6005A, Rev.4 03/2023, https://hydro.com/globalassets/08-about-hydro/hydro-worldwide/austria/nenzing/alloy-data-sheets/hydro-en-aw-6005a.pdf
